Name: Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn
Author: grapeponta
Description:
Not just another map recolour! Featuring fun color palettes, lots of flowers, and holiday decor ✨ Recolours all indoor & outdoor tilesheets, mine levels, and more. This started out as a personal project of grapeponta and now features all edits of the former Redraw Pelican Town mod, fixes by poohnhi and never before seen edits. All in one place!

[b]Using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] is strongly adviced.[/b]


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/62Mfft2J/features.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Recolouring of most vanilla assets[/*]
[*]Redrawing of some assets (e.g. couch furniture, trees, random fixes)[/*]
[*]Two fall terrain colour options (orange or green), various growable grass types (hight, blooming option, greener blue grass)[/*]
[*]Optional aesthetic configs like terrain flower replacements, flowering bushes, snow-covered bushes/fences/rooves during winter[/*]
[*]Reworked visual localization for all officially supported languages (including real support for German)[/*]
[*]i18n integration[/*]
[*]Registered Tokens to further support use of Vibrant Pastoral's features in other mods (C# mod)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][font=Trebuchet MS]Off-site Language Support[/font][/size]
[url=https://cafe.naver.com/f-e/cafes/28468938/articles/521565?boardtype=L&menuid=18&referrerAllArticles=false]🇰🇷 Korean on Naver Cafe[/url]
